issue.title: Split agent-statuses.md so new status rows fit under the reference word cap
issue.description:
Found while landing epic sase-1qz (Agent Hijack). docs/reference/tui/agent-statuses.md was 5986 words before the hijack land phase; that phase's status rows pushed it to 6152, over the 6000-word reference cap, and `tools/check_docs` failed with "This page may not grow. Split it". The landing compressed the hijack entries to a single HIJACKED row pointing at docs/reference/tui/agents-tab-modes.md#hijack-recovery-panel, leaving the page at 5999 words, so HIJACKING…, RECOVERING…, ESCALATED, and CONTINUED have no rows in the status table and any future status addition will fail docs lint.

The page mixes the status tables with unrelated material: Agents Deck Picker, Agent Data Decks and Cards (Deck Views, Card Blocks), and Finalizers on the Agents Tab. Splitting those sections into their own reference page (with redirects per docs/_meta/moves.yml) would leave room to restore full rows for the hijack statuses and overlays. Page moves need owner approval per the docs contract.

task_type_fields.proposal: Move the deck picker, data decks and cards, and finalizer sections of docs/reference/tui/agent-statuses.md to their own reference page with redirects, then restore full rows for HIJACKING…, RECOVERING…, ESCALATED, and CONTINUED.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Page splits and moves need owner approval under the docs contract, so the landing kept the minimal compression instead of restructuring the page.

issue.creation_reason: Landing epic sase-1qz hit the 6000-word cap on docs/reference/tui/agent-statuses.md and had to collapse the hijack status rows to one pointer row; the page now cannot accept any new status.
